title: Accurate predictions of properties of energetic materials with tabular foundation models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14462v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We use TabPFN, a recently developed tabular foundation model, to predict three properties of energetic materials: impact sensitivity, decomposition temperature and crystal density. Without any hyperparameter tuning, TabPFN outperforms the best published models for all three properties. It also substantially outperforms a wide range of established machine-learning models, including tuned gradient boosting (XGBoost), random forests and Gaussian processes. This holds both when the models are given hand-crafted molecular descriptors and when they are given learned representations from Chemprop's message-passing neural network. In particular, for all three properties, TabPFN applied to Chemprop's own embedding is more accurate than Chemprop's predictions. TabPFN is also among the fastest models we consider, more than an order of magnitude faster than XGBoost. As TabPFN predicts the entire distribution of the target rather than just a single v

translated_title: 使用表格基础模型对含能材料性质的精确预测
translated_abstract: 我们使用TabPFN——一种近期开发的表格基础模型——来预测含能材料的三种性质：撞击感度、分解温度和晶体密度。在无需任何超参数调优的情况下，TabPFN在所有三种性质上都优于已发表的最佳模型。它还大幅超越了一系列成熟的机器学习模型，包括经过调优的梯度提升（XGBoost）、随机森林和高斯过程。无论模型使用手工设计的分子描述符，还是使用来自Chemprop消息传递神经网络学习到的表示，这一结论均成立。特别是，对于所有三种性质，将TabPFN应用于Chemprop自身的嵌入表示，其预测精度甚至高于Chemprop本身的预测。TabPFN也是我们所考虑的模型中最快的模型之一，比XGBoost快一个数量级以上。由于TabPFN预测的是目标的完整分布，而不仅仅是单一的（数值估计）……
tldr: 表格基础模型TabPFN无需超参数调优，即可在预测含能材料的撞击感度、分解温度和晶体密度方面超越已发表的最佳模型，且速度比XGBoost快一个数量级以上。
en_tdlr: TabPFN, a tabular foundation model, outperforms the best published models in predicting impact sensitivity, decomposition temperature, and crystal density of energetic materials without any hyperparameter tuning, while being over an order of magnitude faster than XGBoost.
